producer_report.summary: Wrote docs/design/decision-sets.md: typed decision fields (kind, scope with phase, status with named supersession, source, enforcement, plus assumptions/signals), sets computed by scope and applied to role briefs under the existing token budgets (code-checked decisions kept out of briefs, ordered truncation recorded), per-decision assumptions and typed failure signals watched in records so a firing signal puts a decision under review (D87/HTTP 405 worked example), fit with defaults-loop introspection and Jev /v1/evaluate (shadow only, code matching works without it), a six-step migration plan (defaults.toml, D01-D90 incl. prose supersessions, BRIEF addenda, job-record corrections), alternatives, build order and open items. Added D91 to docs/decisions.md, a CHANGELOG entry, and a roadmap RM-4 line. No code changed.

checks_run.note: Ran to completion with no error reported, but the output was too large to display and the saved copy could not be read, so pass/fail was not confirmed from the output. No Rust files changed.
